subject: Recalibrating MAP milestones — Penguin Health evaluation slip & contingency
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@penguinhealth.com>, Penguin Health Procurement <procurement@penguinhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Penguin Health — MAP milestone delay: evaluation infra readiness

Team / Elaine,

Quick update from today's engineering sync at Penguin Health: their infra team discovered a blocker in the test harness required for our end-to-end eval (networking rules + VPC peering isn't scheduled until next week). They estimate a 7–10 business day delay before we can run the full workload.

Implications:
- P0 milestone (eval window start) slips from 2026-12-03 to ~2026-12-13.
- We risk missing the contractual go/no-go gate on 12/10 that was tied to the SOW signature/PO.

Immediate asks:
1) Stephanie — can we offer a short-term contingency (priority queue / reserved slot) to run the eval earlier if they get partial infra available?
2) Ben — confirm whether we can approve a one-off schedule SLA exception (10 business days) and an offer of a one-time credit should we miss the original deadline.
3) Elaine / Procurement — can you confirm whether the PO signature can be moved to a soft-commit (DocuSign intent) to avoid procurement blocking the start?

I attached the latest MAP (v3) and infra logs from Penguin's update for context.

Attachments: Penguin_MAP_v3.xlsx (map), infra-capacity-logs.zip (customer infra report)

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@penguinhealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Penguin Health — MAP milestone delay: evaluation infra readiness

Marcus — thanks for the flag and the logs. Elaine — appreciate the quick heads-up.

Assessment and proposed approach:
- Risk: the 12/10 gate is at risk for sign-off due to the inability to run the full eval. That gate is material for our rollout cadence.
- Short-term mitigation (offered today): reserve two dedicated slots in our staging cluster the week of 12/6 specifically for Penguin's tests (partial-eval path) so they can validate core flows even with limited network config. This reduces the effective slip window to ~3 business days.
- Medium-term mitigation: propose re-baselining the MAP to reflect a new formal eval start on 2026-12-09 with an execution window through 2026-12-16. We'll mark the original 12/10 gate as a 'soft milestone' tied to procurement intent rather than completed infra.
- Commercial concession: offer a one-time evaluation credit (equivalent to two full evaluation days) if we are ultimately unable to deliver within the original calendar gate. Requires Ben's approval.

Action items: 
- Ben: please confirm approval for the credit + SLA exception by EOD 12/1 so I can commit the reserved slots.
- Marcus: please update the MAP spreadsheet (attached) to label which tasks are moving and which remain as dependencies.
- Grace: I'll need a short exec note (1 paragraph) to send to leadership if Ben approves — to request the nominal credit and exception.
- Elaine / Procurement: can you confirm whether a DocuSign soft-commit is possible by 12/3? If procurement needs an updated SOW, I attached SOW-draft_Penguin.pdf for your review.

I will hold the reserved slots for 24 hours pending internal approval. If we can't get Ben's sign-off, we'll need to set up a quick call with leadership.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen | Strategic Accounts Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0145
Attachment: SOW-draft_Penguin.pdf (draft commercial terms)

Hi Stephanie / Marcus,

Thanks — this is helpful and reasonable. Procurement can issue a DocuSign intent (soft-commit) by 12/3; they just need the updated SOW with the adjusted eval window and a clear statement of the contingency credit. I opened a procurement ticket and linked the SOW you attached.

A couple of clarifying questions from our infra team: 
- The reserved slots — will they be fully isolated (no cross-customer caching) and guaranteed throughput? Our perf tests are sensitive to the staging environment behavior.
- If we take the partial-eval approach, will Redwood provide a short checklist for what constitutes a 'pass' for the soft milestone so we can align internal stakeholders?

If you can confirm those two items and Ben confirms the credit, procurement will prepare the DocuSign intent this week. We can also do a 30-minute sync on 12/4 if helpful.

Regards,
Elaine Park
Director of Product, Penguin Health
elaine@penguinhealth.com | +1 212-555-0338

Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penguin Health — MAP milestone delay: evaluation infra readiness (DECISION & NEXT STEPS)

Team — final note to capture decisions and our escalation ask to leadership.

Summary of decisions (approved):
- Ben approved the one-time evaluation credit (2 evaluation days) and the 10-business-day SLA exception.
- We reserved two dedicated staging slots the week of 12/6 for a partial eval (isolated, throughput-guaranteed). Engineering confirmed isolation details to Elaine earlier today.
- Penguin Procurement will issue a DocuSign intent by EOD 12/3; procurement also accepted the updated SOW language around the soft milestone.

Escalation to leadership (requested):
- I will send a 1-paragraph exec note to product & sales leadership asking for the formal credit approval and confirmation this will not set a precedent (this is a one-off concession tied to infra readiness). Grace, please review the draft below and +1 if it looks good.

Draft exec note (please edit):
"Penguin Health (RDW-2026-PENG-0942) experienced an infra readiness delay that prevents a full end-to-end evaluation by the original 2026-12-10 gate. We propose a one-time concession (credit equal to two evaluation days) and a 10-business-day scheduling exception; the customer will provide procurement intent via DocuSign and proceed with a partial eval in the reserved staging slots. Recommendation: approve the credit and exception as a non-precedent commercial concession tied to this specific program's infra blockers"

Next steps:
- Grace: review the draft exec note and reply with edits by 12/6 10:00 PST.
- Marcus: update MAP_v3 with final dates and push to HubSpot link (https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/93492).
- Ben: retention of approval record — please confirm you have added the credit to deal notes.
- Elaine: happy to host the 12/4 sync if there are outstanding technical items; otherwise we proceed with the partial eval plan.

Attachments: Penguin_MAP_v3.xlsx (finalized for this rebaseline), SOW-draft_Penguin.pdf

Thanks everyone — keeping this concise so we can close out approvals.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Strategic Accounts Manager, Redwood Inference
